newsitem.title: USA: Hemasure names chairman, fires officers.
newsitem.headline: Hemasure names chairman, fires officers.

text.p: HemaSure Inc said Thursday that, amid a broad dismissal of the company's executive ranks, Timothy Barberich was elected board chairman.

Barberich has served as a director of the company since its organization in 1993 and serves as president, chief executive and a director of Sepracor Inc, a specialty pharmaceutical company, HemaSure said.

HemaSure said the following officers were relieved of their duties: chairman Eugene J. Zurlo, president and CEO Steven Rouhandeh, executive vice president and chief operating officer Edward Kelly and senior VP and chief financial officer Jeffrey Davis.

The company issued a statement citing "the need to reduce general and administrative expense" as it exits the plasma business and the desire to focus management resources on the company's core business of leukoreduction and viral inactivation technologies as reasons for the dismissals.
The company said its board is in the advanced stages of a search for a new chief executive.
A company spokesperson was not immediately available to elaborate.
HemaSure develops and delivers separations and pathogen inactivation technologies designed to set standards of safety for processing blood components and plasma pharmaceuticals worldwide.
